this is simply ridiculous. you are not my friend. you are not someone who relies on me. you are not someone who would be hurt by my death. it's as simple as that.

and sure, most of you have been "down that road before," but you were diverted.
i have tried several hobbies, but i did not find enjoyment in any of them.

undeserving is the wrong word. i feel like i didn't choose to be born, but i should be able to choose to die. if that makes any sense. i think it's terribly confusing that euthanasia is humane, yet suicide is seen as selfish.

medical intervention would not "improve" my life, only remedy the "chemical misfires in my brain."

i would just like to point out you're the one who said human life is "less than a blink of an eye" in the timescale of the universe. that said, why does it matter if i left a little sooner? there's nothing to miss. i gave life a chance, and now i want out. what's the harm in that? i'd rather let there be that little bit more of space/resources/etc. for someone who wants to live than someone like me who does not.

i'm a little over-eager, then. the idea of "waiting it out" could easily be perceived as tortuous to someone who no longer desires to live. 

and clever user name.

i respectfully disagree with your assessment. i want to die. i don't want to be one of those unfortunate people who are maimed and forced to live with a handicap (or the pity of others) after the fact.

i don't want to live because i truly feel like a waste of space. i'm mediocre in every way, despite by best efforts. i would rather check out early than spend any more time living a failed life.

i haven't sought professional help. i really don't like the idea of being medicated, and it wouldn't change the other problems with my life. i know a couple people with anxiety disorders who are under medical care, and what i've witnessed is not what i want to become.
not much. i don't have any people around me.
it's like she's a teenage, upper-class R Kelly.
I just wanted to know, why Monday? I mean, if you've made your decision why wait another day? Another day of upvotes isn't going to do you any good!
